title: 希望之城 The City Of Hope
description:
Your kingdom has only one piece of land left, and the enemies seem determined not to spare you. How you rebuild a city in a limited time and defeat the powerful invaders depends on your choices.Build a defense systemConstruct several different types of defense towers or deploy your army to resist the enemy's attacks.
CardsEvery day, use randomly generated cards from a pool of over 100 different cards to construct the city, build defenses, establish barracks, and more.
Rich equipment systemChoose from dozens of different equipment options that suit your game strategy to make the game more enjoyable and entertaining.
description_short: A light city-building game that combines elements of card games and tower defense, where players must survive daily enemy attacks and gradually grow their strength to ultimately defeat powerful invaders.
